An administrator must register a native authorization-code OAuth client with a secret, JWT token format and the mcp_server scope; dynamic registration is unsupported. Register the actual Codex redirect and keep the secret in the supported credential store. The connecting user needs sn_mcp_server.viewer and each tool's ACL. Preserve the provider's 26 KB request and 64 KB response limits. Preview writes and obtain user authority for the exact published tool before execution.

plugins.name: rippling

Verify that it is the first-party Rippling workforce MCP, not the separate MCP Gateway or another host. Do not substitute a company-wide API token. An admin access policy and active Rippling AI trial/subscription are required. Use employee OAuth and verify the provider-supported native client flow; there is no upstream client ID or secret to copy. Discover the connected user's authorized codemode.* functions rather than inventing them. Preview and obtain user authority for official time-off requests, draft hires, and custom-object writes before executing them.
